name: azure_postgres_flexible_server
description: Manages an Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server — a managed PostgreSQL instance provisioned within an environment and resource group, with configurable compute, storage, backup, high availability, authentication, and networking.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: Workspace that owns this server (path parameter).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Server name. 3–63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; cannot start or end with a hyphen. Must be globally unique within Azure.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: Environment the server is provisioned into.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: Resource group the server is provisioned into.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scopes the server is visible to. Inherited from the resource group.

attributes.name: postgres_version
attributes.description: PostgreSQL major version. Immutable — Azure does not support in-place major version upgrades.

attributes.name: sku_tier
attributes.description: Compute tier. Burstable is cost-effective for low or variable workloads; GeneralPurpose balances compute and memory; MemoryOptimized suits demanding workloads.

attributes.name: sku_name
attributes.description: Compute size, e.g. Standard_B1ms (1 vCore, 2 GiB) or Standard_B2s (2 vCore, 4 GiB) for Burstable. Must be a size Azure offers for the chosen sku_tier.

attributes.name: storage_size_gb
attributes.description: Storage size in GiB. Azure allows growing storage but never shrinking it.

attributes.name: storage_auto_grow
attributes.description: Whether Azure grows storage automatically as it fills.

attributes.name: storage_tier
attributes.description: Managed-disk performance tier. Leave unset to let Azure pick the default for the chosen storage size.

attributes.name: availability_zone
attributes.description: Availability zone to place the server in ("1", "2" or "3"). Leave unset for no preference. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: backup_retention_days
attributes.description: Number of days to retain automated backups.

attributes.name: geo_redundant_backup
attributes.description: Whether backups are replicated to the paired region. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: high_availability_mode
attributes.description: Standby replica placement. SameZone keeps the standby in the same availability zone; ZoneRedundant places it in a different one. Not available on the Burstable tier.

attributes.name: standby_availability_zone
attributes.description: Availability zone for the standby replica when high_availability_mode is ZoneRedundant. Leave unset to let Azure choose.

attributes.name: maintenance_window
attributes.description: When Azure may apply planned maintenance. Leave unset to let Azure pick the window.

attributes.name: custom_window
attributes.description: Set to Enabled to schedule maintenance for a specific day and time.

attributes.name: day_of_week
attributes.description: Day of the week, 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday).

attributes.name: start_hour
attributes.description: Hour the window starts, 0–23 UTC.

attributes.name: start_minute
attributes.description: Minute the window starts, 0–59.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Azure resource tags. Platform-managed duplocloud-ai-* tags are added automatically and are not tracked here.

attributes.name: administrator_login
attributes.description: Administrator login name. Required when password_auth is Enabled; leave unset in Microsoft Entra-only mode. Letters, numbers and underscores only, cannot start with 'pg_', and Azure reserves several names. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: administrator_password
attributes.description: Administrator password. Required at creation when password_auth is Enabled; on update the backend treats a blank value as "keep the current password". 8–128 characters using at least three of: uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols. Write-only — the API never returns it, so the configured value is kept in state and a change made outside Terraform cannot be detected.

attributes.name: password_auth
attributes.description: Whether PostgreSQL password authentication is accepted. At least one of password_auth and active_directory_auth must be Enabled.

attributes.name: active_directory_auth
attributes.description: Whether Microsoft Entra authentication is accepted. At least one of password_auth and active_directory_auth must be Enabled.

attributes.name: tenant_id
attributes.description: Microsoft Entra tenant (a GUID) that backs Entra authentication. Defaults to the subscription's tenant.

attributes.name: aad_administrators
attributes.description: Microsoft Entra administrators granted access to the server. Only meaningful when active_directory_auth is Enabled. Applied on a best-effort basis after the server is created: Azure keeps the administrators sub-resource unavailable for a while after the server itself reports Ready, so an administrator may not land on the first apply. This is the requested set — `effective_aad_administrators` reports what Azure actually has, and the two converge once a later update reconciles them. Removals only take effect through that update path.

attributes.name: object_id
attributes.description: Entra object id of the user, group or service principal (a GUID).

attributes.name: principal_name
attributes.description: Display name of the principal.

attributes.name: principal_type
attributes.description: Kind of Entra principal.

attributes.name: public_network_access
attributes.description: Enabled exposes the server publicly, gated by firewall_rules. Disabled selects private access (VNet integration) and requires delegated_subnet_resource_id. Immutable after creation — Azure does not allow changing the connectivity method, VNet, or private DNS zone afterwards.

attributes.name: delegated_subnet_resource_id
attributes.description: ARM resource id of the delegated subnet for private access. Required when public_network_access is Disabled, and rejected alongside firewall_rules.

attributes.name: private_dns_zone_arm_resource_id
attributes.description: ARM resource id of the private DNS zone for private access. Leave unset to let the platform create or reuse the well-known zone.

attributes.name: firewall_rules
attributes.description: Inbound IP ranges allowed to reach port 5432. Only valid with public access; the backend rejects rules when public_network_access is Disabled. Use start 0.0.0.0 / end 0.0.0.0 for the "allow any Azure service" rule.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Firewall rule name.

attributes.name: start_ip_address
attributes.description: First address in the allowed range.

attributes.name: end_ip_address
attributes.description: Last address in the allowed range.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: How the platform provisions the server. Defaults to the environment's provisioner.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Provisioner version. Defaults to the environment's version.

attributes.name: azure_resource_group_name
attributes.description: Name of the Azure resource group the server lives in.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Provisioning status reported by the platform.

attributes.name: server_id
attributes.description: Backend identifier of the server record.

attributes.name: postgres_server_id
attributes.description: ARM resource id of the PostgreSQL Flexible Server in Azure.

attributes.name: provisioning_state
attributes.description: Azure-reported provisioning state of the server.

attributes.name: effective_aad_administrators
attributes.description: Microsoft Entra administrators Azure actually reports for the server, read back from the administrators sub-resource. Compare against aad_administrators: the platform applies them best-effort right after create and reconciles them on the next update, so the two can differ briefly.

attributes.name: object_id
attributes.description: Entra object id of the principal.

attributes.name: principal_name
attributes.description: Display name of the principal.

attributes.name: principal_type
attributes.description: Kind of Entra principal.

attributes.name: effective_firewall_rules
attributes.description: Firewall rules Azure actually reports for the server. Applied best-effort immediately after create and reconciled on the next update, so this can lag firewall_rules briefly.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Firewall rule name.

attributes.name: start_ip_address
attributes.description: First address in the allowed range.

attributes.name: end_ip_address
attributes.description: Last address in the allowed range.

attributes.name: fully_qualified_domain_name
attributes.description: Hostname clients connect to on port 5432.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the server record was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the server record was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
